name: Ancient Mesopotamia
description: The earliest recorded evidence of clothing in history.

name: Ancient Egypt
description: The development of advanced textile production techniques.

name: Minoan Civilization
description: Early evidence of sewn garments and tailored clothing.

name: Ancient Greece
description: The introduction of the chiton, a loose garment worn by both men and women.

name: Ancient Rome
description: The toga becomes a key fashion item in Roman society.

name: Medieval Europe
description: The rise of fashion trends among the nobility.

name: Renaissance
description: The development of sumptuary laws to regulate clothing based on social status.

name: Baroque Period
description: Extravagant and elaborate clothing styles dominate European fashion.

name: 18th Century
description: The transition from elaborate Baroque fashion to simple and elegant Rococo styles.

name: Victorian Era
description: The era of corsets, bustles, and hoop skirts.

name: Art Deco
description: The rise of modernist and geometric fashion designs.

name: Great Depression
description: The economic downturn leads to simpler and more affordable clothing styles.

name: World War II
description: Rationing and utility clothing become common during the war.

name: 1950s
description: The era of Poodle skirts, leather jackets, and Greaser fashion.

name: 1960s
description: The rise of counterculture fashion, including mini skirts and hippie styles.

name: 1970s
description: The disco era sees bold and flamboyant fashion choices.

name: 1980s
description: The decade of power suits, shoulder pads, and neon colors.

name: 1990s
description: The era of grunge fashion, oversized clothing, and minimalism.

name: Early 2000s
description: The rise of low-rise jeans, velour tracksuits, and popstar fashion.

name: Contemporary Fashion
description: The diversity and globalization of fashion trends in the modern era.
